lines.text: 一个人可以改一切：脸、房子、家庭、女友、宗教，甚至上帝——但有一样他改不了：改不了激情。
lines.en: A guy can change everything—his face, his home, his family, his girlfriend, his religion, even his God. But there's one thing he can't change: he can't change his passion.
